    Ported from TauCeti (TauCeti.CategoryTheory.Exact.BaseChange, commit 580b6f9d5, Apache 2.0).

    Conflations along admissible base change, and the Noether conflation #

    Quillen's axiom E2 produces a pushout of an inflation along an arbitrary morphism and asserts only that the resulting morphism is again an inflation. This file identifies the cokernel of that inflation: cobase change of a conflation X ⟶ Y ⟶ Z along u : X ⟶ X' produces a conflation X' ⟶ Q ⟶ Z with the same third term. Dually, base change of a conflation along u : Z' ⟶ Z produces a conflation X ⟶ Q ⟶ Z' with the same first term.

    The second half of the file uses this to describe the conflations attached to a composite of two inflations. If X ⟶ Y ⟶ Z and Y ⟶ W ⟶ V are conflations, then the pushout Q of the inflation Y ⟶ W along the deflation Y ⟶ Z is at once the third term of a conflation X ⟶ W ⟶ Q and the second term of a conflation Z ⟶ Q ⟶ V. This is the exact-category form of Noether's second isomorphism theorem, Q ≅ W/X with (W/X)/(Y/X) ≅ W/Y, and it is what makes extension-closed subcategories inherit axiom E1.

    Main definitions #

    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.cobaseChange: the conflation X' ⟶ Q ⟶ Z obtained from S : X ⟶ Y ⟶ Z and a pushout square along u : X ⟶ X'.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.baseChange: the conflation X ⟶ Q ⟶ Z' obtained from S : X ⟶ Y ⟶ Z and a pullback square along u : Z' ⟶ Z.

    Main results #

    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.conflation_cobaseChange and LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.conflation_baseChange: base and cobase change of a conflation along an arbitrary morphism is a conflation; the inflation or deflation in the original conflation is the admissible morphism being pushed out or pulled back.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.conflation_comp_of_isPushout and LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.conflation_comp_of_isPullback: the cokernel of a composite of inflations, and the kernel of a composite of deflations, computed as a pushout resp. pullback.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.exists_conflation_comp: the Noether package for a composite of two inflations.

    References #

    • Theo Bühler, Exact categories, Expositiones Mathematicae 28 (2010), 1--69, https://arxiv.org/abs/0811.1480. Proposition 2.12 identifies the cokernel along a cobase change and Lemma 3.5 is the Noether isomorphism proved here.

            E.Conflation (cobaseChange S sq)

            Cobase change of a conflation is a conflation with the same cokernel. The pushout of a conflation X ⟶ Y ⟶ Z along a morphism u : X ⟶ X' is a conflation X' ⟶ Q ⟶ Z.

            Axiom E2 alone gives only that X' ⟶ Q is an inflation; the content here is that its cokernel may be taken to be the original Z.

            The Noether isomorphism for exact categories. Given conflations X ⟶ Y ⟶ Z and Y ⟶ W ⟶ V, there is an object Q — the pushout of Y ⟶ W along Y ⟶ Z — which is at once the cokernel of the composite inflation X ⟶ W and an extension of V by Z.

            In the classical notation Q ≅ W/X, and the second conflation is Y/X ⟶ W/X ⟶ W/Y. This is Bühler's Lemma 3.5, and it is exactly what an extension-closed subcategory needs in order to inherit axiom E1.

            The dual Noether isomorphism. Given conflations X ⟶ Y ⟶ Z and V ⟶ W ⟶ Y, the pullback Q of W ⟶ Y along X ⟶ Y is at once the kernel of the composite deflation W ⟶ Z and an extension of X by V.
